name: Omatree
author: Tiedeyez
description: Omatree — a living tree on your bar, grown from a seed unique to this machine. Plant it from seed or from a cutting, water and feed it, and prune it by hand into your own shape. Graft in a cutting someone else grew and it can take on genera no solo tree ever rolls — willow, crimson maple, gold zelkova, flowering plum. It ages with your system and with you, slowly, over weeks. A quiet thing to tend once a day. No two are ever alike.

barWidget.description: Your companion tree, living in the bar. Click to tend it; middle-click to water; right-click to set it on your desktop.
